Already in a bechina package.

assignments.reason: This is the node2 of the sole eitza edge (id 2876). It is a long composite node describing the entire evil-prayer phenomenon: that every person accumulates evil prayers (תְּפִלּוֹת רָעוֹת), exemplified by the thief who prays before breaking in (Berakhot 63), and that when one stands to pray properly the evil prayer comes and disrupts — which is the bechina of 'תְּפִלּוֹת כְּנֶגֶד' (opposing prayers). Its essential nature is the evil prayer that opposes proper prayer. This is precisely the domain of Package 2 (תְּפִלּוֹת רָעוֹת / Evil Prayers), which contains the standalone conceptual nodes 'תְּפִלּוֹת רָעוֹת' and 'תְּפִלּוֹת כְּנֶגֶד' — the same concepts embedded in this composite description. The composite node is the narrative expansion of Package 2's core evil-prayer identity.
